info.title: PGLearn HTTP API
info.description: Normative application contract. All JSON responses use data/request_id, except errors. Auth login/reset/callback use Supabase SDK/SSR flows described in integrations. UUID Idempotency-Key is required on user mutations. Unknown fields are rejected; PATCH bodies must contain at least one field. See spec/05 for status mapping, pagination and provider boundaries.

post.description: Pilot scope. Clone only supplied version belonging to program; new draft copies content into new asset identities/keys.

get.description: Owner-only saved response read, permitted after course access expiry; manager/admin cannot read response bodies.

post.description: Structured answer after server-side validation. Same Idempotency-Key is request ID; pending duplicate yields 409 REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS. No client token stream.
Raw Resend webhook body, verified using official SDK signature verification before parsing; payload schema is provider-owned. Body is capped at 1 MiB.

GrantCreate.description: Exactly one of organization_id/user_id is non-null. Subject immutable after creation.

Error.description: Typed error; see spec/05 error code matrix

sessionCookie.name: sb-<project-ref>-auth-token
sessionCookie.description: Supabase SSR cookie family, including chunked cookies; schematic name, use SDK handling.

cronBearer.description: Exact server CRON_SECRET, not user JWT.

webhookSignature.name: svix-signature
webhookSignature.description: Also requires svix-id and svix-timestamp; verify raw body with provider SDK.
